contracts: (The isolated missing-validator test observes identity-invalid and verifies that no successful Replay Result receipt is emitted.) AND (The isolated policy-removal case is rejected, supplies an independent witness, and proves the removed minimum-set member is the only changed input.) AND (The isolated promotion fixture is rejected and its comparison establishes that promotion is the only changed input.)
selector_intents: Execute the missing-validator case in the repository-owned replay test; observe the missing-validator classification assertion fail before the identity-invalid behavior is implemented.
Execute the policy-removal case in the repository-owned replay test; fail when removal of VDD or Acceptance is accepted, lacks an independent witness, or changes another fixture input.
Execute the promotion-request case in the repository-owned replay test; fail when the request is accepted or the fixture differs from its control beyond the promotion input.
